sources.finding: README limits its license statement to source code; lists separate annotation/image downloads.
MIT license covers software and associated documentation; this check does not establish redistribution permission for separate dataset images/reference mask files.
PACO-LVIS derives from LVIS images and provides image/annotation IDs; the image records carry their own license identifiers.

decision: Source photos and reference-mask pixels excluded. Numeric IDs, crop coordinates, source URLs and hashes permit reconstruction from separately obtained copies. Included binary prediction masks and fine/Group maps are generated HPID outputs. No inference of a common image license is made.
repo_license: HPID source snapshots retain their original LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY notices; no new licensing declaration is fabricated.
